title: Game Nihonshi: Kakumeiji Oda Nobunaga
native_title: ゲーム日本史 ～革命児ー織田信長～
overview:
This fellow is a man this unconventional - the truth of history, brought closer through multimedia.

Born into a "turbulent age," a revolutionary who broke down the old ways of the medieval era and tried to open the door to the early modern age - Oda Nobunaga. What was his eventful life like, from his birth to the "Honnoji Incident"...? This software, told through beautiful animated drama and a simulation game, has none of the stiffness of "studying" history. "Experience" Nobunaga's way of life with multimedia history experience software colored by beautiful visuals and sound.

- The main story is portrayed as a full-fledged animated drama. Famous episodes in Nobunaga's life unfold one after another, such as his political marriage to Kicho (Lady No), the funeral of his father Nobuhide where he threw incense at the memorial tablet, and his meeting with Saru (Kinoshita Tokichiro).
- Famous battles such as the "Battle of Okehazama," where he defeated the Imagawa clan, and the "Battle of Nagashino," which displayed the power of firearms, are recreated in a richly tactical simulation game. You can also enjoy the fun of it as a game.
- Includes a database function that explains, with illustrations, the people, events, culture and more that appear in the game. Important historical terms introduced in junior high and high school textbooks are covered.

こやつは、ここまで破天荒な男よ――
マルチメディアだから近づける、歴史の真実。

“乱世”に生まれ、中世の旧弊を打破し、近世の扉を開こうとした一人の革命児――織田信長。その誕生から『本能寺の変』に至るまでの波瀾万丈の生涯とは……？
美麗なアニメーションドラマと、シミュレーションゲームで綴られる本ソフトには、歴史を“学ぶ”という堅苦しさはありません。美しい映像とサウンドが彩るマルチメディア歴史体験ソフトで信長の生きざまを“体験”してください。

●ストーリー本編は本格的なアニメーションドラマで描かれます。帰蝶（お濃の方）との政略結婚、位牌の香を投げつけた父・信秀の葬儀、猿（木下藤吉郎）との出会いなど、信長の人生における有名なエピソードが次々と展開します。
●今川氏を討った『桶狭間の戦い』、鉄砲の威力を見せつけた『長篠の戦い』などの著名な戦いは、戦術性豊かなシミュレーションゲームで再現。ゲームとしての面白さも味わえます。
●データベース機能を搭載し、ゲーム中に登場する人物、事件、文化などを図版入りで解説。中学・高校の教科書で紹介されている重要歴史用語が網羅されています。
